name: Acolyte

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (prayers), Holy Symbol, Parchment (10 sheets), Robe, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description: You devoted yourself to service in a temple, either nestled in a town or secluded in a sacred grove. There you performed rites in honor of a god or pantheon. You served under a priest and studied religion. Thanks to your priest instruction and your own devotion, you also learned how to channel a modicum of divine power in service to your place of worship and the people who prayed there.

name: Criminal

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) 2 Daggers, Thieves' Tools, Crowbar, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description: You eked out a living in the shadows, surviving through wit, stealth, and connections others would rather not admit to having. Crime is a profession like any other, and you have learned to treat it that way — efficiently, dispassionately, and profitably.

name: Sage

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Calligrapher's Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8 sheets), Robe, 8 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description: You spent your formative years in libraries and scriptoriums, poring over ancient texts and absorbing knowledge on every subject. Your mentors pushed you to question everything, verify your sources, and never confuse popular belief with established fact. You emerged brilliant, curious, and probably insufferable at dinner.

name: Soldier

proficiency_choices.desc: Choose one kind of Gaming Set (see "Equipment")

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set (same as above), Healer's Kit, Quiver, Traveler's Clothes, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description: You trained as a warrior and fought in organized military service — a standing army, a mercenary company, a city militia, or a noble household guard. You learned to follow orders, hold a formation, and keep fighting when everything was going wrong. The discipline stayed with you.

name: Artisan
description: You began mopping floors and scrubbing counters in an artisan's workshop for a few coppers per day as soon as you were strong enough to carry a bucket. When you were old enough to apprentice, you learned to create basic crafts of your own, as well as how to sweet-talk the occasional demanding customer. Your trade has also given you a keen eye for detail.

proficiency_choices.desc: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tool

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (chosen), 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Charlatan
description: You're an expert at getting people to do what you want, and you know how to get out of trouble. You've talked your way into noble courts and out of death sentences. Barely. The code you live by is simple: take the money and run. Lies are tools, and you wield them masterfully.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Forgery Kit, Costume, Fine Clothes, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Entertainer
description: You've always had a gift for performance. Perhaps you danced in the streets for coin, played a circuit of taverns and noble courts, or trained under a master of the performing arts. Wherever you performed, you've learned what an audience wants — and how to give it to them.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (chosen), Costume, Mirror, Perfume, Traveler's Clothes, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Farmer
description: You grew up connected to the land. You know the rhythms of planting and harvest, the signs of bad weather and blight, and how to coax life from unforgiving soil. Hard work is your birthright, and you carry a quiet resilience that sustains you when others falter.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Carpenter's Tools, Healer's Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Guard
description: You served as a guard — at a city gate, a noble's estate, a merchant caravan, or a prison. The work was often tedious and occasionally dangerous. You learned to stay sharp when others grew complacent, and to read a crowd for signs of trouble before it started.

proficiency_choices.desc: Choose one kind of Gaming Set

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (chosen), Hooded Lantern, Manacles, Traveler's Clothes, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Guide
description: You grew up in the wilderness, navigating trackless forests, frozen peaks, and sun-scorched plains. You know how to read the land, find water, avoid predators, and move without leaving a trace. Others rely on you to take them safely through places they couldn't survive alone.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Cartographer's Tools, Bedroll, Fishing Tackle, Hunting Trap, Traveler's Clothes, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion — a cave in the hills, a ruined tower, a monastery at the edge of the world. Isolation sharpened your mind and deepened your connection to the natural or spiritual world. You emerged with knowledge few others have sought, and a perspective shaped by long silence.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Herbalism Kit, Blanket, Book (notes/prayers), Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Merchant
description: You worked in trade — buying low, selling high, reading people, and moving goods across dangerous roads. You know the value of everything and the price of trust. Your experience has made you adaptable, persuasive, and comfortable operating in the grey areas between legal and profitable.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator's Tools, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Noble
description: You were born or adopted into wealth and privilege. You were tutored in history, etiquette, and statecraft, and you grew up understanding that power is held as much through perception as through force. The world treated you well — and you've learned exactly how to use that.

proficiency_choices.desc: Choose one kind of Gaming Set

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (chosen), Fine Clothes, Perfume, Signet Ring, Traveler's Clothes, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Sailor
description: You've lived on the water — fishing vessels, merchant ships, naval galleys, or worse. You know how to read the weather, tie a knot that holds, navigate by stars, and keep your footing when the deck pitches in a storm. The sea is unforgiving, and it made you the same way.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator's Tools, Rope (50 ft.), Traveler's Clothes, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Scribe
description: You trained as a scribe in a government office, a noble's household, a wizard's tower, or a commercial scriptorium. You learned to copy documents with perfect accuracy, write in multiple scripts, and spot an inconsistency in a contract at twenty paces. Information is your trade, and you know better than most how valuable it can be.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Calligrapher's Supplies, Fine Clothes, Parchment (10 sheets), Small Knife, Traveler's Clothes, 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP

name: Wayfarer
description: You grew up on the road or the river, part of a traveling community — traders, wanderers, or outcasts who moved from place to place and survived by reading people and situations quickly. You learned early that the world is not always welcoming to those without a fixed home, and you developed the skills to navigate it anyway.

equipment_options.desc: Choose A or B: (A) Thieves' Tools, Bedroll, 2 Pouches, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
